name: How Hard Can It Really Be?
source:
You play as Celia a 21 year old NEET that (un)fortunately gets isekai'd by truck-kun. As if her day couldn't get any worse, she gets bound to a dragon spirit that turns her into a futanari. Join her as she "grows" stronger and create new bonds in an absurd world full of clichés.

[From [url=https://waterthose.itch.io/how-hard-can-it-really-be]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演21岁的家里蹲少女西莉亚，她不知该算幸运还是不幸地被“卡车君”撞去了异世界。仿佛这一天还不够倒霉似的，她又与一头龙之精灵缔结了契约，摇身一变成了扶她。伴随她在这个套路满满的荒诞异世界里不断“变大变强”，与各色人物结下全新的羁绊吧。

[摘自[url=https://waterthose.itch.io/how-hard-can-it-really-be]itch.io[/url]]
